texts.Giving_RecurringHealth_Intro: Your monthly recurring revenue and the recurring gifts at risk: a failed charge, a card about to expire, a cancellation at the processor or a payment gone overdue. Processor news arrives as Recurring Gift Events from your Zapier recipe.
texts.Giving_RecurringHealth_TaskCreated: Follow-up task created for you, due today.
texts.Giving_RecurringHealth_Unmatched: {0} processor events match no recurring gift. Open Recurring Gift Events, Unmatched Events, and choose the Commitment for each.
texts.Giving_RecurringHealth_Unexpected: Recurring Donor Health could not do that. The details are in the Error Log.
texts.Giving_Acknowledgment_TemplateNotFound: The email template {0} for rule {1} is missing. Edit the rule on the Thank-Yous page and choose another template.
texts.Giving_Acknowledgments_ErrorReorderNotPe: Changing the order of the rules needs the Manage BarnCRM Settings permission.
texts.Giving_Acknowledgments_Intro: What is waiting to be thanked and the buttons that send it. Emails send from here or overnight. Letters come out as a spreadsheet you merge with your own letter and print.
texts.Giving_Acknowledgments_LettersReady: The letter file is ready on the run below. Merge it, print it, and then choose Mark as Sent.
texts.Giving_Acknowledgments_NoRules: You have no rules yet, so no gift is being queued for a thank you. Add one with New Rule.
texts.Giving_Acknowledgments_NotScheduled: Not scheduled. Nothing goes out until you choose Send Emails Now.
texts.Giving_Acknowledgments_RulesHelp: Rules are considered from the top: the first one that matches a gift decides its thank you. Drag a rule, or use Move Up and Move Down, to change the order.
texts.Giving_Acknowledgments_TemplateFieldHelp: The email this rule sends. The list shows every active email template in your org. To add a template or change its wording, use Setup, under Email Templates.
texts.Giving_AskPipeline_Empty: No open asks yet. Choose New Ask, or add one from a person's or organization's page.
texts.Giving_AskPipeline_Intro: Every open ask by stage. Drag a card to another stage, or use its menu to move, close or reopen it.
texts.Giving_AskPipeline_LinkHelp: Choose a gift or a pledge from this ask's donor.
texts.Giving_AskPipeline_NextAskHelp: When to ask this donor again. Optional.
texts.Giving_AskPipeline_ReopenConfirm: The ask from {0} goes back on the board at {1}. A gift or pledge it recorded stays linked to it.
texts.Giving_AskPipeline_Reopened: The ask from {0} is open again, at {1}.
texts.Giving_CommitmentNew_EndHelp: Fill in one: the number of payments or the date of the last one.
texts.Giving_CommitmentNew_ErrorAmountEachTime: Enter the amount of each payment, above zero.
texts.Giving_CommitmentNew_ErrorLastDate: The last payment date is before the first payment date. Change one of them.
texts.Giving_CommitmentNew_ErrorNoDonor: Choose the donor: a person or an organization.
texts.Giving_CommitmentNew_ErrorRecurringSched: Enter how often the donor gives and the date of the first payment.
texts.Giving_CommitmentNew_ErrorTwoDonors: Choose one donor: a person or an organization, not both.
texts.Giving_CommitmentNew_ErrorUnexpected: The commitment could not be saved, and nothing was changed. The Error Log has the details.
texts.Giving_CommitmentNew_PreviewEmpty: Fill in the amount, how often and the dates to see the payments here before you save.
texts.Giving_CommitmentNew_PreviewPledge: {0} payments of {1}, the last one {2} on {3}.
texts.Giving_CommitmentNew_PreviewRecurring: {0} each time, the first on {1}. More payments are added as they come due.
texts.Giving_Donate_GoalItem: What we set out to raise
texts.Giving_Donate_NoGift: No gift was written for online payment {0}: the payment or the donor could not be found. Check the Form Submission and the payment, then enter the gift by hand.
texts.Giving_Donate_NoPayments: BarnCRM Payments is not installed, so online gifts cannot be taken.
texts.Giving_Donate_Offline: Online giving for this appeal is not open right now. Contact us to give.
texts.Giving_DonorLevels_Empty: You have not created any levels yet. Choose New Level to add the first rung of your ladder.
texts.Giving_DonorLevels_Intro: Your giving ladder. Each rung is a name for a group of donors and the amount that reaches it. Donors move onto it automatically as their giving changes.
texts.Giving_DonorPanel_LoadError: The donor summary could not be loaded. You can still enter the gift.
texts.Giving_DonorPanel_NoCommitments: No open pledges or recurring gifts.
texts.Giving_FundSplit_BarHint: Drag a divider on the bar, or select it and press the arrow keys, to move money between two funds.
texts.Giving_FundSplit_DuplicateFund: Each fund can be chosen once. Put all of its amount on one row.
texts.Giving_FundSplit_NeedsAmount: Give every row an amount. A refund's amounts are all below zero, like the refund.
texts.Giving_FundSplit_NeedsFund: Choose a fund on every row, or remove the row.
texts.Giving_FundraisingHome_DonorLevelsHelp: Your giving ladder: the levels and the amount each one starts at.
texts.Giving_FundraisingHome_LoadError: Fundraising Home could not be loaded. Reload the page. If it keeps happening, the Error Log has the details.
texts.Giving_FundraisingHome_PledgeRemindersHe: Reminders for upcoming and overdue scheduled payments, and what is due to go.
texts.Giving_FundraisingHome_ReceiptsHelp: The receipt letters donors read, and this year's statements.
texts.Giving_FundraisingHome_StewardshipPlansH: The follow-up plans your organization repeats, and their steps.
texts.Giving_GiftAllocations_NoDelete: Taking a fund off a gift deletes its allocation, and you do not have delete access to Gift Allocations. Ask your BarnCRM admin to make this change.
texts.Giving_GiftAllocations_None: This gift is not allocated to any fund yet.
texts.Giving_GiftAllocations_Saved: Funds saved. The gift's allocations now match the split.
texts.Giving_GiftBatch_CreatedNote: These gifts have been created. Each line links to its gift. To correct a gift, refund or write off that gift.
texts.Giving_GiftBatch_ErrorAlreadyCreated: The gifts for this batch have already been created. Creating them again would enter every gift twice.
texts.Giving_GiftBatch_ErrorCreateFailed: No gifts were created. The batch is still here as you left it.
texts.Giving_GiftBatch_ErrorEditAfterCreate: The gifts for this batch have been created, so its lines can no longer be changed. To correct a gift, refund or write off that gift.
texts.Giving_GiftBatch_ErrorNoAccess: You can see this batch but not change it or create its gifts. Ask your BarnCRM admin for the Giving Staff permission set, or for edit access to this batch.
texts.Giving_GiftBatch_ErrorNoControlTotal: Enter the control total from the deposit slip before creating the gifts, so there is something to check against.
texts.Giving_GiftBatch_ErrorNoRows: This batch has no lines yet, so there are no gifts to create.
texts.Giving_GiftBatch_ErrorOverControlTotal: This batch does not balance: the lines add up to {0} more than the control total. Look for a line entered twice or a mistyped amount, then choose Create Gifts again.
texts.Giving_GiftBatch_ErrorRowsIncomplete: Some lines are not finished. Fix the lines marked below, then choose Create Gifts again.
texts.Giving_GiftBatch_ErrorShortOfControlTota: This batch does not balance: the lines add up to {0} less than the control total. Find the missing gift or correct the control total, then choose Create Gifts again.
texts.Giving_GiftBatch_FromBatchHelp: Leave date, payment method, fund or appeal empty and the line uses the batch's.
texts.Giving_GiftBatch_NoLinesHelp: Choose Add Line and type the first check.
texts.Giving_GiftBatch_UseComputer: Batches are easier on a computer. On a phone, scroll the lines sideways to reach every column, or use Quick Gift Entry for a single gift.
texts.Giving_GiftEntryPays_Help: Payments this donor still owes on active or paused pledges and recurring gifts. Choose one to link the gift to it, or None for a gift on its own.
texts.Giving_GiftEntry_ErrorOneDonor: Choose one donor: a person or an organization, not both.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorBrandAmbiguous: More than one brand is named {0}. Use the brand's record ID instead.
texts.Giving_NightlyJobs_AskRemindersDescripti: Creates a task for the donor's owner when the donor's Next Ask Date arrives. Does nothing while Ask Reminders is off in Settings.
texts.Giving_NightlyJobs_Intro: Five jobs keep giving moving overnight: they extend recurring schedules, mark payments overdue, place donors on their giving level, send pledge reminders, and remind owners when a donor's next ask arrives. None runs until you schedule it here, and the two reminder jobs also wait for their setting.
texts.Giving_NightlyJobs_LevelsDescription: Places every donor on the rung their giving now reaches. Runs after the rollups have settled.
texts.Giving_NightlyJobs_OverdueDescription: Marks an unpaid payment Overdue once it is further past its due date than the grace period.
texts.Giving_NightlyJobs_PledgeRemindersDescri: Sends the reminder steps due for upcoming and overdue scheduled payments. Does nothing while Send Pledge Reminders is off in Settings. You can also stop it on the Pledge Reminders page.
texts.Giving_NightlyJobs_TopUpDescription: Extends every active recurring commitment up to the generation horizon.
texts.Giving_PayOnline_EmailBody:
Hello {0},

Here is your secure link to pay {1} on {2}:

{3}

The link opens our payment provider's page, where you enter your card. It works once, for a limited time; if it expires, choose Pay Online in the portal again.

Thank you for your support.
texts.Giving_PayOnline_NoEmail: We have no email address for you, so we can't send a payment link. Contact us to pay.
texts.Giving_PayOnline_NotActive: This pledge or recurring gift is not active, so nothing is due on it.
texts.Giving_PayOnline_NotReady: Paying online isn't available right now. Contact us to pay.
texts.Giving_PayOnline_NotSent: A donor portal payment link was not emailed. The donor can choose Pay Online again; check the org's email deliverability if it repeats.
texts.Giving_PayOnline_NothingDue: Nothing is due on this pledge right now.
texts.Giving_PayOnline_Sent: We've emailed you a secure link to pay. It may take a few minutes to arrive.
texts.Giving_Periods_Intro: Close the books through a date when a month is finished. No gift dated on or before it can be added, or have its date, amount, donor, payment method, reference or funds changed, or be deleted. Refunds and write-offs are dated today, so they still work.
texts.Giving_Periods_ReopenNote: Moving the date back reopens a closed period. It needs the Override Posting Lock permission, granted in Setup, and it is written to the Error Log.
texts.Giving_PledgeReminders_Intro: Reminders for scheduled payments of pledges and recurring gifts that are coming due or overdue. Each step fires a set number of days before or after a payment's due date, by email or letter. Only the latest step due for a payment is sent, and every reminder is logged below.
texts.Giving_PledgeReminders_NoSteps: No steps yet. Add the first step, for example an email 7 days before the due date and another 14 days after.
texts.Giving_PledgeReminders_TemplateFieldHelp: The email template this step sends. Use merge fields from the scheduled payment, such as the due date and the amount, so each donor sees their own.
texts.Giving_PostingCard_ClosedPeriod: Dated in a closed period, so its date, amount, donor, payment method, reference and funds stay locked. The books are closed through
texts.Giving_PostingCard_Unposted: Unposted. The reason is in the Error Log. After your next export, choose Mark These Gifts Posted on the Accounting Export page to post it again.
texts.Giving_QuickGiftEntry_ErrorMatchedGift: Only an organization's gift can match an employee's gift. Choose a gift from the list, or leave it empty.
texts.Giving_QuickGiftEntry_ErrorSplit: A split is for a gift of money: choose a different fund on every row, give each an amount, and make the rows add up to the gift's amount.
texts.Giving_QuickGiftEntry_ErrorTributeType: Choose whether this gift is in honor of someone or in memory of them.
texts.Giving_QuickGiftEntry_FairMarketValueHel: For your reporting only. It is never printed on the receipt and never added into a giving total. Leave it empty if you do not have a figure yet.
texts.Giving_QuickGiftEntry_InKindDescriptionH: This is printed on the donor's receipt word for word. Write what a stranger would recognize a year from now.
texts.Giving_QuickGiftEntry_MatchEmpty: No gift to match yet: nobody whose Employer is this organization has a gift that is not already matched.
texts.Giving_QuickGiftEntry_MatchHelp: Gifts from people whose Employer is this organization, newest first. The employee is recognized on this gift with a soft credit.
texts.Giving_QuickStatus_CancelPendingGift_Con: Cancel this pending gift? It is marked Cancelled, and a scheduled payment it was expected to pay is open again.
texts.Giving_QuickStatus_CancelPendingGift_Not: Only a pending gift can be cancelled. A gift that was received is refunded or written off instead.
texts.Giving_QuickStatus_DoNotThank_Confirm: Take this gift out of the thank-you queue? No thank you is sent for it.
texts.Giving_QuickStatus_DoNotThank_Done: No thank you will be sent for this gift.
texts.Giving_QuickStatus_DoNotThank_NotApplica: This gift is not waiting for a thank you, so there is nothing to skip. To send one, use Thank Again.
texts.Giving_QuickStatus_MarkPlanComplete_Conf: Mark this stewardship plan complete? Its status becomes Complete, with today as its Completed Date.
texts.Giving_QuickStatus_MarkPlanComplete_NotA: This plan is not running, so there is nothing to complete.
texts.Giving_QuickStatus_ReopenAsk_Confirm: Reopen this ask? Its outcome goes back to Open and it returns to its stage on the Ask Pipeline. A gift or pledge it recorded stays linked.
texts.Giving_QuickStatus_ThankAgain_Confirm: Thank this donor again? The gift goes back into the queue on the Thank-Yous page and is sent with the next run.
texts.Giving_QuickStatus_ThankAgain_Done: The gift is back in the thank-you queue.
texts.Giving_QuickStatus_ThankAgain_NotApplica: This gift is already waiting for a thank you on the Thank-Yous page.
texts.Giving_Receipt_LetterheadNote: Your organization's name, address and logo print above this letter on every document. To change them, change your organization and receipt settings, not the letter.
texts.Giving_Receipt_NoRunsMessage: Choose a statement year and select Generate to produce one statement of the year's gifts for each donor.
texts.Giving_Receipt_PreviewNote: This shows the wording with the sentences BarnCRM adds. To check the printed page, issue a receipt for a test gift.
texts.Giving_Receipt_TaxNote: The tax wording is not in this letter and cannot be edited. Whatever you write here, BarnCRM adds the sentences a valid receipt must carry: whether goods or services were provided, the quid pro quo disclosure with its good faith estimate and deductible amount, and the intangible religious benefits sentence.
texts.Giving_Receipt_TokensIntro: Tokens you can use. Type each one exactly as shown, with both pairs of braces:
texts.Giving_Receipt_VoidConfirmMessage: The receipt stays on file as Void and a new one is issued with the next receipt number. This cannot be undone.
texts.Giving_Receipt_VoidNote: The receipt the donor already has is never changed or deleted. Voiding records why, and the replacement takes the next number.
texts.Giving_SchedulePreview_CancelMessage: The {0} unpaid payments are marked Skipped and no more are added. Gifts already received are not touched.
texts.Giving_SchedulePreview_Empty: No payments have been generated for this commitment yet.
texts.Giving_Segments_ChampionsDescription: Donors whose giving pattern is Champion: they gave recently, often and generously.
texts.Giving_Segments_Empty: No segments yet. Save one from a template above, or save a Find query of people or organizations.
texts.Giving_Segments_Intro: Named lists of donors chosen by their giving. Count them, see who is in them, and export a file to import into Mailchimp or Constant Contact. BarnCRM sends nothing.
texts.Giving_Segments_LapsedDescription: Gave last year and nothing yet this year.
texts.Giving_Segments_LevelMoversDescription: Moved from one donor level to another in the last 90 days.
texts.Giving_Segments_MajorProspectsDescriptio: A largest gift of 1,000 or more or total giving of 5,000 or more, and a gift in the last two years.
texts.Giving_Segments_NewDescription: Made a first gift in the last 365 days.
texts.Giving_Segments_SlippingDescription: Donors whose giving pattern is At Risk: they gave often or generously before, but not recently.
texts.Giving_Segments_UpgradersDescription: Gave last year and has already given more this year than all of last year.
texts.Giving_SetupAssistant_FundAppealStepDesc: Pick where a gift goes when nobody says otherwise.
texts.Giving_SetupAssistant_IdentityDescriptio: Record the name, tax identification number, address, logo, and signature that appear on your receipts and letters.
texts.Giving_SetupAssistant_VerifyDescription: Follow the short walkthrough that adds a person, a household, and a first gift, so you know the setup is right.
texts.Giving_SetupNote_Email_What: Let this org send email, so emailed thank yous can go out.
texts.Giving_SetupNote_Email_Why: Salesforce sends no thank you emails unless Deliverability is set to All email, and only Setup can change it.
texts.Giving_SetupNote_FromAddress_Steps: Click Add.|Enter the display name and address, choose who may use it, then click Save.|Open the email Salesforce sends to that address and click its verification link.|Back here, choose the address in Acknowledgments from address.
texts.Giving_SetupNote_FromAddress_What: To send thank yous from a shared address such as giving@yourorg.org, add and verify it as an organization-wide address.
texts.Giving_SetupNote_FromAddress_Why: Salesforce sends from a shared address only once Setup has added and verified it; without one, thank yous come from whoever sends them.
texts.Giving_SetupNote_RecordPages_Steps: Click Edit next to Gift Record Page.|Click Activation, then Assign as Org Default, and save.|Do the same for Giving Contact Record Page and Giving Account Record Page, choosing App Default and the BarnCRM app.
texts.Giving_SetupNote_RecordPages_What: Assign Gift Record Page as the org default for Gift, so every gift shows the Receipts, Soft credits and Tribute panels. To show giving in the BarnCRM app, also assign Giving Contact Record Page and Giving Account Record Page to it.
texts.Giving_SetupNote_RecordPages_Why: Only Setup can assign a record page as a default, for the org or for an app.
texts.Giving_SetupNote_Templates_Steps: In the Folder list, choose BarnCRM Acknowledgments.|Click BarnCRM: thank you for your gift, then Edit, or click New Template to write your own.|Change the wording, then click Save.
texts.Giving_SetupNote_Templates_What: Write or change what an emailed thank you says in an email template. BarnCRM ships one to start from: BarnCRM: thank you for your gift.
texts.Giving_SetupNote_Templates_Why: Salesforce keeps template editing, preview and test sends in its own editor, for everybody.
texts.Giving_SoftCredits_AutomaticHelp: BarnCRM created this credit from the household and keeps it up to date. Change the gift, or who is in the household, and it follows.
texts.Giving_SoftCredits_Empty: Nobody else is recognized for this gift yet.
texts.Giving_SoftCredits_RecomputeDeferred: Salesforce was too busy to update household soft credits for {0} households just now. They catch up the next time each gift is saved.
texts.Giving_Stewardship_Empty: You have not written a plan down yet. Choose New Plan to write the first one.
texts.Giving_Stewardship_FieldMinimumHelp: Only for the two gift events. Leave it empty to start on any gift.
texts.Giving_Stewardship_Intro: The follow-up your organization repeats. Write a plan down once here, and BarnCRM lays its tasks out every time the plan applies.
texts.Giving_Stewardship_NoSteps: This plan has no steps yet, so it would start and lay nothing out. Add the first step.
texts.Giving_Stewardship_SelectPlan: Choose a plan to see and edit its steps.
texts.Giving_Stewardship_StepSubjectHelp: What the assignee reads in their task list. Write it as an instruction: Call to say thank you, not Thank you.
texts.Giving_TributeNotification_Empty: This gift was not given in honor of or in memory of anyone.
texts.Giving_Erase_GiftsKept: Kept with their amounts and dates, credited to the anonymous record, so totals stay right.
texts.Giving_Erase_ReceiptsKept: Kept as tax records. Their PDF documents still print the donor's name and address: delete them by hand once your rules allow it.
texts.Giving_HealthCheck_OverrideLockDetail: The Override Receipt Lock permission lets a person change or delete a gift that has a receipt number. BarnCRM grants it to nobody: assign it in Setup for one correction, then remove it. It is held by {0}. If no one is correcting a receipted gift, remove it in Setup, Custom Permissions. Changes made with it are in the Error Log.
texts.Giving_HealthCheck_ReceiptFailedManyDeta: {0} receipts are Void with the reason Generation failed, so those donors are still waiting for their documents. Read the receipt entries in the Error Log, fix what they name, and run the receipts again. Leave the void records alone: they account for the numbers that were used.
texts.Giving_HealthCheck_ReceiptFailedOneDetai: One receipt is Void with the reason Generation failed. That is a number handed to a document that never generated. A single one is ordinary, not a problem. The Error Log says what went wrong, and the receipt can be run again once it is fixed.
texts.Giving_HealthCheck_UnpostedClosedPeriodD: These gifts are locked because their date is on or before Books Closed Through, but none is marked posted to accounting. If they belong in an export you already sent, mark them posted on the Accounting Export page (Mirror). If not, move Books Closed Through back (needs the Override Posting Lock permission).
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorAmountNotPositive: The amount must be more than zero.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorAmountUnreadable: The amount {0} is not a number BarnCRM can read.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorAppealAmbiguous: More than one appeal is named {0}.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorCannotDeleteGifts: A gift import needs permission to delete gifts, because it removes a gift it could not finish. Ask your BarnCRM admin for the Giving Admin permission set.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorCustomRoleMissing: A soft credit with the role Other needs Soft credit: custom role.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorDateUnreadable: The date {0} cannot be read. Write it as 2026-03-15, or the way your Salesforce locale shows dates.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorDonorChoice: Gift: donor must be Contact1, Organization or Household, not {0}.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorDonorHouseholdMissing: Gift: donor says the household gave the gift, and the row has no household.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorDonorOrganizationMiss: Gift: donor says the organization gave the gift, and the row has no organization.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorDonorPersonMissing: Gift: donor says the first person gave the gift, and the row has no first person.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorExternalIdRepeated: Gift: external ID {0} names a gift that already exists, and this template never matches.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorFailed: The gift could not be saved: {0}
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorFundAmbiguous: More than one fund is named {0}. Use its accounting code instead.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorFundNotFound: No fund is named {0}, or has it as its accounting code.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorInKindAmount: An in-kind gift has no amount. Leave Gift: amount empty or 0, and put what the goods were worth in Gift: fair market value.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorMatchOnlyNone: Gift: this template only pays scheduled payments, and no open payment of this donor is due near this date for this amount.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorMatchTie: Gift: two scheduled payments are equally close to this gift, {0} and {1}. Link it to one by hand, or give the row an external ID of an existing gift.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorNeverMatchInstallment: Gift: this gift matches the scheduled payment {0}, and this template never matches.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorNoDonor: The row names nobody to give the gift: map a person or an organization.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorNotAttempted: Not attempted: this chunk ran out of room before this gift could be finished. Load this row again.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorPartsWithoutGift: The row has fund, soft credit or tribute columns but no gift amount, so there is nothing to allocate or credit.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorSoftCreditPartyChoice: Soft credit: credit whom must be Contact1, Contact2, Organization or Household, not {0}.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorSoftCreditPartyMissin: The soft credit names nobody the row has: map a second person, or say in Soft credit: credit whom who to credit.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorSoftCreditRoleUnknown: The soft credit role {0} is not one BarnCRM knows. Use one of: {1}.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorSplitAmountsDiffer: The split adds up to {0}, not the gift amount of {1}.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorSplitMixed: A split gives every part as an amount, or every part as a percent, not a mix.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorSplitPartIncomplete: Part {0} of the split needs a fund and either an amount or a percent, not both.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorSplitPercentsDiffer: The split percents add up to {0}, not 100.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorTributeHonoreeMissing: A tribute needs Tribute: honoree name.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorTributeTypeUnknown: The tribute type {0} is not one BarnCRM knows. Use one of: {1}.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorTypeMissing: The gift has no payment method. Map a column to it, or give the template a default payment method.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorTypeUnknown: The payment method {0} is not one BarnCRM knows. Use one of: {1}.
texts.Giving_Import_ErrorValueUnreadable: The value {0} in {1} cannot be read.
texts.Giving_Import_LogAttributesNotLoaded: These gift columns name no gift field the import may write, and were not loaded: {0}.
texts.Giving_Import_LogPaymentsMatched: Gifts that pay a scheduled payment: {0}.
texts.Giving_Import_UndoKeptClosedPeriod: Kept: this gift is dated in a closed accounting period. If it was a mistake, record a refund: it is dated today.
texts.Giving_Import_UndoKeptDonor: Kept: a gift this import made, which the undo is keeping, still names this record.
texts.Giving_Import_UndoKeptPosted: Kept: this gift is posted to accounting. If it was a mistake, record a refund, or ask your bookkeeper to unpost it first.
texts.Giving_Import_UndoKeptReceipted: Kept: a receipt lists this gift, and the donor holds it. Void the receipt, then refund or write off the gift, if it was a mistake.
texts.Giving_Import_UndoKeptStatement: Kept: a year-end statement issued to the donor lists this gift. Void the statement first if the gift was a mistake.
texts.Giving_JobNotice_AcknowledgmentsBody: {0} gifts processed, {1} thank you emails sent, {2} could not be sent. Open the run for the details.
texts.Giving_JobNotice_DonorLevelsBody: {0} donors moved to a different level.
texts.Giving_JobNotice_StatementsBody: {0} donors checked, {1} statements issued, {2} batches with errors. Open the run for the details.
texts.Giving_NightlyJobs_NotScheduled: The nightly jobs are not scheduled, so no schedule is being extended and no payment will turn Overdue on its own.
texts.Giving_NightlyJobs_PermissionRequired: Scheduling the nightly jobs needs the Manage BarnCRM Settings permission.
texts.Giving_NightlyJobs_ReadOnly: You can see whether the jobs are running. Changing the schedule needs the Manage BarnCRM Settings permission.
texts.Giving_NightlyJobs_RunFailed: The run failed. The reason is in the Error Log.
texts.Giving_NightlyJobs_RunNowStarted: The top up, the overdue pass and the reminders that are turned on have started. Refresh this page in a minute to see what they did.
texts.Giving_NightlyJobs_Stale: This job was due and did not record a run. Open the Error Log to see why.
texts.Giving_NightlyJobs_TopUpSummaryFormat: Extended {0} recurring schedules. {1} chunks could not be extended and are in the Error Log.
texts.Giving_SampleData_ErrorInvalidData: The Giving sample data file could not be read. Regenerate it with scripts/data/generate-sample-data.py and deploy it again.
texts.Giving_SampleData_ResourceMissing: The Giving sample data file is not in this org, so the gifts, appeals and funds cannot be loaded. Deploy the GivingSampleData static resource and try again.
